title: 多階層速率整形、有效速率計算與宿主保底頻寬 (Multi-Tier Rate Shaping, Effective Rate & Host Reserve)
expected: Effective rate is min(plan_rate_limit, fup_tier_rate, exit_per_member_limit) per direction, never below minimum_rate when forwarding is allowed; node installs tc HTB + fq_codel on fvmb0 (download) and fvup0 (upload) with host reserve class 1:fffe protecting the control channel.
actual: Live serving exit fvpn-w4-usage-node installed kernel tc HTB + fq_codel on fvmb0 and fvup0 with host reserve class 1:fffe (100Mbit) and per-member classes at effective_rate = min(plan=80M/40M, tier0=100M/50M, exit=60M/30M) = 60Mbit down / 30Mbit up, shaped concurrent memberA (+1106/+1513 B) and memberB (+1066/+1515 B) flows, and preserved mTLS control-plane responsiveness (HTTP 200).
